executive_verdict: Preserve the verified action/model/PPO/checkpoint/evaluation engineering, but supersede the frozen PPO-first sequencing. Use exact-deck recurrent autoregressive imitation as a competence warm start only after a strict teacher/deck/replay-safety gate, then permit a bounded KL-regularized recurrent PPO phase. Maintain a deterministic Mega Lucario specialist as a continuously shippable hedge. Do not authorize the 15M-choice scratch programme, full TPU training, unconditional search, or offline Q-learning now.

first_three_experiments.title: Exact-deck teacher and replay-safety qualification
first_three_experiments.decision_resolved: Whether imitation is legally, semantically, and statistically defensible for any specialist before training.
first_three_experiments.hypothesis: At least one exact 60-card archetype has a recent, settled, policy-consistent teacher corpus with >=25,000 valid meaningful decisions and no unresolved action alignment.
first_three_experiments.strongest_alternative: Public replay selection is too biased, teacher identity/deck is too uncertain, or labels cannot be authorized; imitation should be abandoned.
first_three_experiments.inputs_and_provenance: Official episode/deck interfaces; current daily top-episode indices; project semantic replay loader; exact deck SHA-256; teacher/rating/date receipts. Raw bodies are not in this audit pack and must be acquired under separate authorization.
first_three_experiments.deck: Mega Lucario default; Starmie challenger; Dragapult as high-complexity comparator.
first_three_experiments.teacher_or_opponent_population: At least 2 independent strong teachers per candidate, plus lower-rated and losing episodes for coverage diagnostics.
first_three_experiments.choice_game_update_budget: 0 training choices; target >=200 episodes and >=25k meaningful decisions for a passing deck.
first_three_experiments.checkpoint_resume_plan: Versioned acquisition manifest; content hashes; append-only audit; no mutable labels.
first_three_experiments.primary_metric: Valid full-action label rate, exact-deck certainty, teacher consistency, duplicate-adjusted episode/decision count, matchup/time coverage.
first_three_experiments.negative_controls: Attempt parsing intentionally shifted actions; cross-deck teacher mixing; duplicate episodes; forced/setup rows.
first_three_experiments.screening_threshold: One candidate with exact legal 60-card list, >=1 strong teacher, >=5k valid decisions, zero unresolved labels.
first_three_experiments.confirmation_threshold: Exact list + >=2 independent recent teachers + >=25k meaningful decisions + episode-level dedup/splits + zero unresolved labels + documented license/authorization.
first_three_experiments.catastrophic_stop_conditions: Any hidden/private leakage, invalid labels, deck mismatch, unauthorized data use, duplicate contamination across splits, or unresolved compound-action reconstruction.
first_three_experiments.pass_next_action: Authorize E02/E03 for the passing deck through a new decision record.
first_three_experiments.fail_next_action: Stop imitation; retain deterministic hedge and run only bounded PPO canary after E04.
first_three_experiments.ambiguous_next_action: Acquire the smallest missing sample or a second teacher; do not train.
first_three_experiments.entry_gate: Read-only acquisition/analysis authorization and official rules check.
first_three_experiments.priority_rationale: It can invalidate the recommended path before any material compute and resolves the largest unknown.

first_three_experiments.title: Minimal CABT actor/learner bridge qualification
first_three_experiments.decision_resolved: Whether the proven PPO components can operate on real CABT trajectories without semantic, recurrent, or lifecycle corruption.
first_three_experiments.hypothesis: A minimal bridge can reproduce stored compound log-probabilities, attach both-player boundaries, and run 100 games with zero reliability events before any optimizer step.
first_three_experiments.strongest_alternative: Integration defects dominate and make both on-policy evaluation and fine-tuning unsafe.
first_three_experiments.inputs_and_provenance: Frozen G1/G2/G3a source/configs, exact engine/card/deck hashes, rule opponents, no training.
first_three_experiments.deck: Mega Lucario engineering candidate plus Mega Abomasnow smoke anchor.
first_three_experiments.teacher_or_opponent_population: Random legal and included rule agents.
first_three_experiments.model_initialization: Frozen G2 checkpoint or deterministic freshly initialized policy for no-update qualification.
first_three_experiments.trainable_parameters_and_losses: No optimizer steps; all parameters frozen.
first_three_experiments.compute_platform: Local/private CPU first; T4x2 only after local pass.
first_three_experiments.checkpoint_resume_plan: Attempt-scoped manifests; exact request/action traces; deterministic bridge resume test.
first_three_experiments.primary_metric: Zero invalid/fallback/stale/out-of-order/owner-crossing events; old compound log-prob max error <=1e-5; terminal/truncation classification 100%.
first_three_experiments.negative_controls: Injected stale request, duplicate action index, worker death, forced-only step, partial multi-select/STOP, two-player terminal ordering.
first_three_experiments.screening_threshold: 10 games complete with zero reliability events and exact action replay.
first_three_experiments.confirmation_threshold: 100 games and >=10k decisions, zero reliability events, deterministic checkpoint/resume parity.
first_three_experiments.catastrophic_stop_conditions: Any silent fallback, swallowed worker failure, nonzero policy lag, recurrent ownership crossing, unclassified terminal, or replay mismatch.
first_three_experiments.pass_next_action: Permit E05 and real on-policy evaluation.
first_three_experiments.fail_next_action: Do not run PPO; fix bridge while BC/offline analysis and deterministic hedge continue.
first_three_experiments.ambiguous_next_action: Reduce to a single-process trace and classify every discrepancy.
first_three_experiments.entry_gate: No omitted native asset required for source audit; execution requires authorized private engine.
first_three_experiments.priority_rationale: It is the hard safety gate for all learned-policy field testing and can run in parallel with data qualification.

first_three_experiments.title: Native option-order signal ablation
first_three_experiments.decision_resolved: Whether suppressing raw option position discards a cheap, competition-relevant prior.
first_three_experiments.hypothesis: A small normalized option-position embedding improves held-out log loss and on-policy strength without creating brittle permutation dependence.
first_three_experiments.strongest_alternative: Option order is spurious, engine-version-specific, or causes shortcuts that fail under perturbation.
first_three_experiments.inputs_and_provenance: E01-qualified exact-deck labels; semantic projection; native order retained only in one branch.
first_three_experiments.deck: First E01-qualified deck, expected Mega Lucario.
first_three_experiments.teacher_or_opponent_population: Qualified teachers; held-out teacher, time, matchup, and episode splits.
first_three_experiments.model_initialization: Same seed/model; order-blind control versus position-feature treatment.
first_three_experiments.trainable_parameters_and_losses: Recurrent autoregressive BC; all G2 parameters trainable; token cross-entropy including STOP.
first_three_experiments.choice_game_update_budget: 5k labels per arm; 200 screening games per arm against fixed population.
first_three_experiments.checkpoint_resume_plan: Checkpoint at 1k/5k labels; exact config/model/data hashes.
first_three_experiments.primary_metric: Held-out full-action NLL and exact match; on-policy paired win-rate delta.
first_three_experiments.negative_controls: Randomly permuted legal-option order at validation; option-0 deterministic policy; uniform policy; card-ID-only model.
first_three_experiments.screening_threshold: Position arm improves held-out NLL >=5% relative and no permutation-control collapse >10 pp.
first_three_experiments.confirmation_threshold: At least +5 pp paired on-policy win rate with no held-out archetype regression >3 pp at >=400 games/arm.
first_three_experiments.catastrophic_stop_conditions: Illegal action, reliance on missing position at submission, >10 pp collapse under semantically equivalent option permutation, or leakage of teacher action index.
first_three_experiments.maximum_compute_loss: <=1.5 GPU hours plus <=1 CPU evaluation hour.
first_three_experiments.pass_next_action: Include position feature with permutation regularization in E03.
first_three_experiments.ambiguous_next_action: Increase to 25k labels only if offline metrics and 200-game result disagree.
first_three_experiments.priority_rationale: Forum evidence suggests native order can be unusually strong; this is a cheap, falsifiable architecture decision.

largest_unknown: Whether a current, exact-60-card, strong-teacher corpus can be acquired and authorized with enough policy consistency and matchup coverage to produce on-policy competence that transfers to the non-stationary hidden ladder before 2026-08-16.
decision_reversal_triggers: No archetype passes E01 confirmation by 2026-07-26: abandon imitation and focus deterministic hedge plus a single 100k-choice PPO canary after E04.
E03 100k BC fails >=70% full-action exact, >=40% teacher H2H, >=5 pp rule-baseline gain, or held-out floors: stop imitation expansion.
A predeclared scratch PPO 100k canary unexpectedly exceeds 55% held-out aggregate with lower bound >50% while BC fails: reconsider PPO-first for that exact deck.
Starmie passes exact-list/data gates and beats Lucario by >=8 pp pooled with no important matchup regression: switch learned specialist.
E05 KL-PPO regresses aggregate >=5 pp or any important matchup >=10 pp: abandon that RL configuration and revert to BC.
Deterministic specialist reaches and sustains the operational top-10 frontier under sufficient settled games: prioritize packaging/evaluation over learning.
Official runtime/search API differs materially from archived assumptions: suspend search and rerun package qualification.
